title: Adobe Campaign Classic (ACC) is affected by an Improper Control of Generation of Code ('Code Injection') vulnerability…
description: Adobe Campaign Classic (ACC) suffers from a critical code injection vulnerability (CVE-2026-104351) that allows a low-privileged attacker to execute arbitrary code without user interaction. The vulnerability affects the current user context and changes the security scope. It has a very high CVSS score of 9.9, indicating severe impact on confidentiality, integrity, and availability.
